essence: Having performed the bed-ascension, the teacher should reverently lay the deity down.
The teacher should place the vardhanī vessel in the region of Uma's head.
Having meditated on each respective half-body part there, the teacher should worship it.
The best teacher should worship with principal offerings such as fragrance, garlands, incense, and food.
Having placed the octad of earth-forms, one should also place the lord of the forms.
